description: MainActivity.java: Defines the main activity of an Android application, setting up fragments, menu options, and logging mechanisms.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for the Android app, manages UI setup, options menu, logging, and fragment transactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds the AdvancedImmersiveModeFragment if no saved state exists.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Adjusts menu item visibility and title based on current view state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, toggling log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain with wrappers and filters, and displays the log fragment.
